digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API and external live tests
propositions: rebar.llm.review_ticket() public API was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking pass but two external test modules still call it, causing 4 CI lane failures with AttributeError

review_ticket calls in test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py::test_pydantic_review_ticket_opus and test_llm_trace.py::151 are not simple renames — review_plan lacks the positional graph-target-kind argument and returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT instead of REVIEW_RESULT
external test modules are excluded from the standard Verified gate, so the removal epic's pytest run never exercised them and the regression remained invisible until live workflow_dispatch
both modules must retarget to rebar.llm.review_code (surviving op with REVIEW_RESULT contract matching runner/model/findings assertions) rather than review_plan
